heading: Reference to chapter 1223
lead: Provisions of law relating to retired pay for nonregular service are set forth in chapter 1223 of this title (beginning with section 12731).

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Prior sections 1331 to 1338 were renumbered sections 12731 to 12738 of this title, respectively.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 103–337, div. A, title XVI, § 1662(j)(7), Oct. 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 3005.)
